Name: BAGI Icon Collection for Meads and Honeys in Cometkin's Style
Author: Sodapip
Description:
Do you use the BAGI, and the Mead trifecta ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5767]Flower Meads[/url], [url=https://github.com/daleao/bagi-meads]Better Mead Icons[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10996]Better Beehouses[/url]) alongside [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Artisan Goods[/url], and get a little annoyed when all the honey and mead sprites don't all look the same?
This mod aims to fix that issue. It adds sprites in the style of cometkin's Better Artisan Goods to go along with BAGI, Flower Meads, and Better Beehouses/Fruit Tree Honey that are all compatible with PPJA - More Trees, Mizu's Flowers, Ancient Crops, and Quaint Living. Make all your new honeys and meads have the same artstyle, while still having unique sprites.

How to (Un)Install:
*PLEASE make sure all prerequisite mods are installed! Or else this isn't going to work!!!
Step 1: Download the file for whichever crop mods you are using
Step 2: Unzip the file into your 'mods' folder
Step 3: Done!
Uninstallation: Simply delete the folder from your 'mods' folder. That's it!
